HEMFRID SÖKER STOR- OCH FLYTTSTÄDARE I UPPSALA – BLI EN DEL AV VÅRT TEAM!
Hemfrid är Sveriges största företag inom hemstädning. Vi hjälper våra kunder med städning, fönsterputs och andra tjänster i hemmet, alltid med kvalitet och omtanke.

Vad erbjuder vi? 
· En tjänst på 75% i sysselsättningsgrad
· Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor 
· Fast månadslön – samma lön varje månad 
· Milersättning mellan kunder för dig som kör egen bil i tjänst 
· Betalt restid mellan kunderna 
· Försäkringar (sjukdom, ansvar och tjänstepension) 
· Vi värnar om din hälsa! Därför erbjuder vi ett friskvårdsbidrag på 2 400 kr per år 
· Gratis mobilabonnemang 
· Kostnadsfri utbildning i hemstädning samt vidareutbildningar inom service och städning 
· Field Lead/Buddy – kontaktperson inom städning samt stöd till medarbetare ute på fältet 
· Teamträffar och gemensamma fester 
Vi letar efter dig som:

Tycker om att jobba i team med andra kollegor

Ha tidigare erfarenhet inom städning

Är engagerad och vill utvecklas inom städning

Pratar svenska eller engelska

Kunna arbeta flexibla timmar

Har B-körkort

Det är starkt meriterande om du tidigare har arbetat som hemstädare, hushållerska eller motsvarande.
Som Stor- och Flyttstädare arbetar man ofta i grupp, möter nya kunder och miljöer varje dag och är trygg i att ta ansvar för både utförande och slutbedömning av städningen.

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroller. För att vara kvalificerad för den här tjänsten behöver du ha ett svenskt personnummer eller ett samordningsnummer.

HEMFRID IS LOOKING FOR DEEP CLEANERS AND MOVE-OUT CLEANERS IN UPPSALA – JOIN OUR TEAM!
Hemfrid is Sweden’s largest home cleaning company. We help our customers with cleaning, window cleaning, and other home services – always with quality and care.
We are now looking for you who want to work as a Deep Cleaner / Move-out Cleaner in our OneTime team in Uppsala and surrounding areas. With us, you will become part of an international team with colleagues from all over the world, together delivering world-class service!
What do we offer?

A 75% position

Collective agreement and secure employment conditions

Fixed monthly salary – the same salary every month

Mileage compensation between customers if you use your own car for work

Paid travel time between customers

Insurance (health, liability, and occupational pension)

We care about your health! That’s why we offer a wellness allowance of SEK 2,400 per year

Free mobile phone subscription

Free training in home cleaning and further education in service and cleaning

Field Lead/Buddy – a contact person and support for employees in the field

Team meetings and social events

We are looking for someone who:

Enjoys working in a team with other colleagues

Has previous experience in cleaning

Is committed and wants to develop within cleaning

Speaks Swedish or English

Can work flexible hours

Holds a Category B driver’s license and access to a car

Previous experience as a home cleaner, housekeeper, or similar is highly meritorious.
As a Deep Cleaning and Move-Out Cleaner, you often work in teams, meet new customers and environments every day, and are confident in taking responsibility for both the execution and final quality assessment of the cleaning.
Our process
As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks. To be eligible for this position, you need to have a Swedish personal identity number or coordination number.

About Us
At Stellar Capacity, we empower individuals and organizations to thrive amid digital transformation. Through cutting-edge programs in leadership, AI, innovation, and change, we partner with clients globally to accelerate impact.
As we scale, we're seeking a results-driven Strategic Business Developer to fuel growth, deepen client relationships, and help us deliver transformational experiences.
In this role, you will be at the forefront of how organizations across different industries understand, explore, and work with AI. If you're excited by the idea of empowering others through education, we’d love to hear from you.
Your Role
As a Strategic Business Developer you will partner with clients to understand goals, explore options, and co-create clear program proposals. Work alongside our design, marketing, and operations teams to ensure a consistent and seamless experience from first meeting through delivery. You’ll also participate in AI programs to gather insights, strengthen relationships, and identify thoughtful next steps.
Identify new business opportunities by understanding client needs and challenges, and articulating the transformative impact AI can have on their business.
Develop and advance pipeline through targeted outreach and timely follow-up; align with marketing on campaigns and events.
Run discovery and solutioning: diagnose goals, shape recommendations, and translate needs into clear program proposals.
Own core deal stages: qualify, scope, propose, negotiate, and close mid- to large-size engagements.
Lead key relationships: serve as the day-to-day point for strategic accounts; steward executive touchpoints and stakeholder alignment.
Support “all things program + sales”: contribute to decks, one-pagers, agendas, briefs, delivery checklists, follow-ups, and case studies.
Partner cross-functionally: channel client and market insights to refine offerings, messaging, and GTM; ensure strong handoffs to delivery.
Represent the brand at webinars, workshops, and industry events- and convert interest into next steps.

What You Bring
Experienced in sales or business development (edtech, training, consulting, or services a plus) ideally from a fast-moving environment, selling technology, data or digital transformation solutions.
Exceptional relationship-building skills and natural ability to connect with people at every level, turning first conversations to long-term partnerships.
Confident with outbound outreach and meeting activity/pipeline targets.
Creative and solution-oriented mindset; you think beyond templates to design what fits the client best.
Strong presentation and storytelling skills with senior stakeholders; clear, persuasive writing.
Experienced in supporting program delivery (workshops, cohorts, trainings) and collaborating across teams.
Organized, process-driven, and comfortable with CRM, funnel metrics, and forecasting.
Genuine curiosity about AI, leadership, and learning; you like turning ideas into action.
Fluent in English and Swedish.

How You Operate
You thrive in high-velocity environments and keep standards high while moving quickly. You’re proactive, resourceful, and hungry to do your best- willing to roll up your sleeves and do what it takes to turn opportunities into impact. You stay grounded, put the mission and team ahead of ego, and measure success by shared results.
What we offer: 
Hands-On Impact: A unique opportunity to drive sales for high-impact programs that empower leaders and organizations worldwide.
Dynamic Environment: Be part of a vibrant, innovative team that values creativity, collaboration, and results.
High Candor, Low Ceremony: We give direct, respectful feedback - fast.
Career Advancement: Accelerate your career in a rapidly expanding company with opportunities for leadership and professional growth as a member of our leadership team.
Global Opportunities: Build relationships with top professionals and organizations across the globe.

Ready to make an impact?
If you want to help organizations take their next step with AI, and you thrive where relationships, strategy and results meet, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV and few lines about why this role speaks to you. We review applications continuously, so don't wait to apply.
